mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 73 degrees with overcast skies down at Fireman's Park, all under a full moon.

September 2026 is officially Hunger Action Month in Verona, a proclamation by Mayor Diaz to support nutrition security, alongside roadwork on Highway M which will require flaggers this Monday and Tuesday to assist with utility connections.
Enjoy the Dane County Farmers Market today, get ready for the Kids Triathlon tomorrow, or look forward to Yoga at Insight Wellness on August 31.
In our weekly look back, officers conducted a traffic stop on August 21 and cited a 28-year-old Madison man for possession of marijuana.
